portfolio.title: Enterprise E-Commerce & Retail Management Platform (Poshdori)
portfolio.shortDesc: A high-performance online storefront and comprehensive admin dashboard built to manage and scale a growing fashion retail brand.
portfolio.fullDesc:
Built as a complete digital retail solution, this platform provides a seamless, fast shopping experience for customers while equipping business owners with a powerful command center to manage their entire operation. From tracking live inventory and processing orders to monitoring system health and managing staff access, the system handles the complete retail lifecycle.

Under the hood, the platform is designed for enterprise-level scale, security, and reliability using a Distributed Microservices architecture:

• **Front-End Experience:** Built two distinct React.js applications (Public Store and Admin Panel) deployed via Cloudflare to ensure lightning-fast global access and security.
• **Robust Backend Core:** Engineered a complex network of Java Spring Boot microservices hosted on a custom-configured Linux server environment.
• **Scalable Architecture:** Orchestrated the microservices using Netflix Eureka for dynamic service discovery and a Spring Cloud API Gateway for efficient traffic routing.
• **Asynchronous Processing:** Implemented RabbitMQ for event-driven communication, allowing complex background tasks (like updating inventory or logging audit trails) to happen instantly without slowing down the user experience.
• **Data Isolation & Security:** Utilized separate MySQL databases for core business logic and dedicated audit logging, paired with strict Role-Based Access Control (RBAC) to protect sensitive data.

portfolio.title: Enterprise UI Modernization & Analytics Dashboard (Adeptia)
portfolio.shortDesc: Collaborated with a large development team to transition a B2B enterprise application to a modern React architecture, and independently engineered an interactive data visualization dashboard.
portfolio.fullDesc:
When the company decided to refresh their legacy B2B platform, I worked alongside our development team to drive the UI modernization. The goal was to replace the older interface with a highly responsive, modern React.js architecture that could handle complex enterprise data efficiently. Work was highly collaborative, and I engineered a strict library of reusable React components that were implemented across multiple complex application entities.

While the broader modernization was a distributed team effort, a major personal highlight of this project was single-handedly engineering the platform's central command dashboard to give users instant, visual insights into their application data.

• **UI/UX Architecture:** Collaborated on the frontend migration from Ext JS to React.js, building reusable components that established the foundation for the new UI.
• **Advanced Data Visualization:** Independently architected and developed the complete interactive dashboard from scratch utilizing MUI v6 React Charts.
• **Complex Data Rendering:** Implemented dynamic pie charts, bar graphs, and custom metric formats to visualize heavy, real-time application data clearly and efficiently.

portfolio.title: B2B Data Automation Platform Engineering (Adeptia)
portfolio.shortDesc: Contributed to a ~30-person development team maintaining an intelligent B2B data automation platform, engineering solutions for both monolithic and microservices deployment architectures.
portfolio.fullDesc:
I worked as part of a ~30-person development team responsible for the core engineering and maintenance of Adeptia's intelligent data automation platform—a system designed to turn messy, incoming first-mile data into clean, structured information. Work was highly distributed, requiring us to be adaptable and work across the full stack based on our experience levels.

A unique engineering aspect of this product was its dual-architecture offering. We developed and maintained the software to run as both a traditional monolithic application and a modern microservices architecture, allowing different enterprise clients to utilize the system according to their specific infrastructure requirements. By collaborating closely with client services and QA teams, we translated direct client feedback into tangible features.

• **Dual-Architecture Engineering:** Developed and optimized backend services using Java Spring Boot, ensuring feature parity, stability, and performance across both the monolithic and microservices versions of the platform.
• **Data Automation Logic:** Engineered backend processes to support the platform's core capability of ingesting, transforming, and structuring complex B2B data feeds.
• **Legacy System Management:** Shared responsibilities in maintaining and updating existing frontend interfaces built on Ext JS, ensuring stability for established clients.
• **Cross-Functional Agile Delivery:** Actively managed the software defect lifecycle, resolving complex bugs reported by the QA team to maintain high system reliability.
• **Client-Driven Development:** Implemented database schema updates and backend improvements directly driven by client functionality requests and service team meetings.

portfolio.title: Face Recognition & GPS Attendance App
portfolio.shortDesc: A smart Android application that automates attendance tracking using facial recognition and location-based GPS verification.
portfolio.fullDesc:
To solve the problem of proxy attendance and the time wasted on manual tracking, I co-developed a secure Android application that acts as an automated attendance management system. The core engineering challenge was combining two distinct validation layers into a seamless mobile experience.

By utilizing the device's hardware, the app ensures that a user is both who they say they are, and exactly where they are supposed to be.

• **Biometric Validation:** Integrated facial recognition technology using the device camera to accurately identify the user attempting to log attendance.
• **Strict Geofencing:** Utilized Android GPS to cross-reference the user's physical coordinates with the required classroom or office boundary. Attendance is only logged successfully if the location accurately matches.
• **Role-Based Dashboards:** Engineered comprehensive data views allowing users to check their daily and monthly attendance history, while providing teachers and employers with a master dashboard to monitor all student or employee records.
• **Secure Cloud Architecture:** Implemented Firebase for backend database management and secure user authentication flows, including email verification and encrypted credential storage.

portfolio.title: 2-Factor IRIS Biometric Authentication System
portfolio.shortDesc: A Python-based 2FA security system developed by a 2-person team, utilizing a custom-trained machine learning model for iris recognition.
portfolio.fullDesc:
As a 4th-year academic project, I collaborated in a 2-person team to build a high-security 2-Factor Authentication (2FA) system. Instead of relying on standard SMS codes, we implemented an immutable biological marker—the human iris—as the second layer of verification.

• **Custom ML Model Training:** Trained a specialized machine learning model using a dataset of approximately 30,000 eye images to accurately identify and differentiate unique iris patterns.
• **Zero-Trust Authentication Flow:** Designed a dual-layer login system where users first authenticate via traditional credentials (username/password) before being challenged by the biometric layer.
• **Real-Time Image Processing:** Integrated camera functionality to capture real-time facial/eye images during both the registration (profile storage) and login (verification) phases.
• **Identity Verification Logic:** Engineered the backend script to securely compare live camera captures against stored biometric profiles, outputting a strict success or failure state based on the iris match.

portfolio.title: Campus Lost & Found Android App
portfolio.shortDesc: An Android application built as a semester project by a 4-person team to help users report, locate, and securely claim lost items through in-app messaging.
portfolio.fullDesc:
Developed as a 3rd-year semester group project, this native Android application centralizes the recovery of lost items within a campus or local community. Working in a 4-person team, we engineered a digital platform to replace disorganized physical notice boards with a clean, searchable digital feed.

• **Interactive Feeds:** Built dedicated 'Lost' and 'Found' sections where users can publish detailed posts containing images, short descriptions, dates, and location coordinates.
• **Secure In-App Chat:** Engineered a real-time messaging system allowing the finder and the owner to communicate seamlessly to coordinate the item's return. To protect privacy, only the user's name is visible without exposing personal contact info.
• **Status Management:** Implemented post-state toggles allowing users to mark items as 'resolved' once returned, keeping the public feeds clean and up-to-date.
• **User Accountability:** Integrated a standard signup and login authentication flow to ensure all posts and messages are tied to verified users.
